name: Wavelet blend (DWT sub-bands)
plain: Decomposes a and b with a wavelet transform, blends low and high sub-bands with separately chosen modes and factors, and inverts. Optional sub-band offsets per level. The FIXME comments flag doubts about 5D reshaping, and a debug print fires on each call.
math:
aL,aH=DWT(a); bL,bH=DWT(b)
L=fL(aL,bL,t·ol); Hk=fH(aHk,bHk,t·oh); out=IDWT(L,H), trimmed to input size

props.params: wave, level, mode, blend_mode_yl, blend_mode_yh, offsets, use_dtcwt
